title: Validation of 2D video-based movement analysis tools for assessing human fall impact kinematics

key_results: Kinovea achieved highest agreement for peak vertical velocity (ICC=0.902); all tools underestimated velocity by 9% average; AI tools showed ICC 0.83-0.90 for horizontal velocity
comments: Controlled lab setting with young healthy adults; surveillance footage validation still needed for practical application.

model_io.model: Six 2D pose estimation tools (Kinovea, OpenPose, RTMPose, MediaPipe-lite/full/heavy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: 2D video pose estimation can approximate 3D MOCAP accuracy
hypotheses.result: Agreement achieved (ICC 0.83-0.90 for horizontal; 0.902 for vertical in Kinovea) but systematic underestimation persists (~9% average)

title: Analytical choices and mission context shape rodent spaceflight transcriptomic inference
task: Assessing reproducibility and transportability of spaceflight transcriptomic findings across missions
key_results: Only 1 of 37 targets met FDR<0.05 across eight liver flight-ground contrasts; Cyp7a1 heterogeneous externally (log2FC=0.20, I²=83.4%) vs RR-6 (−1.54); analytical choices substantially altered gene testability
comments: Meta-analysis revealing substantial context-dependence of spaceflight transcriptomics; gene-level conclusions require specification-aware interpretation.

inputs: Gene expression from five independent rodent spaceflight missions (38 predefined clock/bile-acid targets)

model_io.model: Sensitivity analyses (count matrices, filtering, feature spaces)
inputs: RR-6 liver and colon RNA-seq data with alternative preprocessing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clock and bile-acid genes show consistent spaceflight dysregulation across missions
hypotheses.result: Minimal targets achieved multiplicity-adjusted significance; Cyp7a1 highly heterogeneous; Abcg5 more consistent but lost support with expanded cohorts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Analytical choices minimally impact transcriptomic conclusions
hypotheses.result: Filtering and feature-space choices substantially altered gene testability and apparent biological totals; broad patterns stable but gene-level conclusions specification-dependent

title: Landscape and clinical impact of heterogeneous ALK resistance mutations detected by comprehensive genomic profiling in patients with NSCLC
task: Characterizing ALK resistance mutations and therapeutic outcomes in ALK-rearranged NSCLC
key_results: Secondary ALK mutations detected in 8.0% (269/3344) ALK+ samples; G1202R most common (42.4%); contraindicated TKI treatment associated with shorter rwPFS (4.6 vs 26.4 months)
comments: Large NGS dataset (134,948 specimens) with real-world EHR outcomes; repeat testing at progression recommended to guide therapy selection.

model_io.model: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) for secondary ALK mutations
inputs: Tissue and liquid biopsies from NSCLC patients

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specific ALK mutations confer resistance to particular TKI generations
hypotheses.result: G1202R, I1171N, L1196M most frequent; off-target resistance associated with poor rwPFS (2.7 months)

title: Deep learning predicts IDH1 mutation status in acute myeloid leukemia from bone marrow smears
task: Predicting IDH1 mutation status in acute myeloid leukemia from histopathology images
key_results: Attention-based multiple-instance learning achieved mean single-pooled ROC-AUC of 0.81 across four centers; model predictions associated with immature leukemia phenotypes
comments: Multicenter validation (Germany and US) on 436 AML patients; interpretable model highlights immature blast morphology linked to IDH1 status.

inputs: Bone marrow smear whole-slide images (436 AML patients, 4 centers)

hypotheses.hypothesis: IDH1 mutations associate with specific morphological phenotypes in AML bone marrow smears
hypotheses.result: Model predictions for IDH1 associated with immature leukemia phenotypes; ROC-AUC 0.81 indicates moderate diagnostic utility

title: Microbiology Galaxy Lab: a community-driven gateway for reproducible and FAIR analysis of microbiological data
task: Building community-driven platform for reproducible FAIR microbiological data analysis
key_results: Microbiology Galaxy Lab integrates 315+ tool suites, 115 curated workflows, 35+ tutorials; supports metabarcoding, genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic analysis across health and environmental microbiology
comments: Global, freely accessible platform democratizing microbial omics analysis; extensive community support maintains resource currency and best-practice workflows.

inputs: Microbial omics data (metabarcoding, metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, metaproteomics)
outputs: AMR tracking, biomarker predictions, microbiome classifications

title: An agentic AI system enhances clinical detection of immune-related adverse events in a multi-phase validation study
task: Detecting and extracting immune-related adverse events from clinical notes using agentic AI with human verification
key_results: Retrospective macro-averaged F1 0.92 for irAE detection, 0.66 for severity grading; prospective silent deployment F1 0.72-0.79; randomized crossover study showed 2.71-min time reduction (P<0.001), improved annotation accuracy (OR 1.45), and interannotator agreement (α 0.22-0.51→0.82-0.85)
comments: Cost ~$0.02/note; prospective deployment shows realistic performance gaps versus retrospective; human-AI collaboration substantially improves annotation consistency.

model_io.model: Agentic large language model system for irAE extraction
Clinical annotation with agentic AI assistance vs manual

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agentic AI reduces manual annotation burden for adverse event detection
hypotheses.result: Time reduced 2.71 min (P<0.001); complete-match accuracy improved (OR 1.45, P=0.045); agreement elevated from α 0.22-0.51 to 0.82-0.85

title: Antimicrobial use contributes to resistance gene enrichment across cattle groups on commercial dairy farms
task: Quantifying antimicrobial use impact on dairy cattle resistome composition across farm groups
key_results: High AMU associated with increased resistance to aminoglycosides, β-lactams, macrolides; resistance richness/diversity highest in calves; tetracycline resistance ubiquitous regardless of AMU
comments: Farm-level AMU data linked to metagenomic fecal resistomes; calves represent key population for resistance surveillance in agricultural systems.

model_io.model: Metagenomic analysis of bovine fecal resistomes
inputs: Fecal samples from calves, lactating cows, sick cows, cull cows
outputs: richness and diversity metrics by host group

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher antimicrobial use correlates with enriched specific resistance classes
hypotheses.result: High AMU farms showed increased aminoglycoside, β-lactam, macrolide resistance; tetracycline resistance ubiquitous regardless

hypotheses.hypothesis: Host developmental stage influences resistome composition independently of AMU
hypotheses.result: Calves showed highest resistance gene richness and diversity compared to adult cows

title: Layer-wise Prediction for Interpretation of Hidden Representations in Deep Neural Networks through Evolving Probability Distributions
task: Interpretability of hidden layer representations in DNNs
key_results: LPI achieves superior consistency, stability, fidelity and certainty metrics compared to AdditionalLayer, SDN, MetaGF, and DFS baselines
comments: Proposes layer-wise probability distribution mapping with reconstruction strategy; fidelity gains depend on reconstruction faithfulness to actual DNN mechanisms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mapping each hidden layer to a probability distribution reveals DNN decision evolution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through consistency and fidelity metrics across multiple models

title: A training-free, domain-extensible LLM-based approach for automated extraction of standardized preparation procedures
task: Automated extraction of standardized laboratory synthesis procedures from text
key_results: Training-free LLM-based method outperforms open-source tools; matches state-of-the-art domain-specific models on zeolite synthesis; generalizes across chemistry fields
comments: Leverages explicit action sets and readily available LLMs without fine-tuning; pragmatic approach to digitizing millions of published synthesis procedures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs with explicit domain knowledge generalize across synthesis domains without fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms open-source, matches domain-specific models

title: Adaptive critic learning control for wastewater treatment plants
task: Adaptive critic learning control for wastewater treatment
key_results: Reduces IAAE by 23.3% and 13.5%, ISE by 41.6% and 18.3%, cumulative cost by 44.0% and 32.5% vs. nominal ADP and PI control respectively over days 2-14
comments: Continuous-time H∞ game formulation with integral Bellman relation avoids need for drift dynamics; practical performance on nonlinear wastewater model under realistic disturbances and uncertainty.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Critic-based adaptive control balances tracking, cost, and disturbance attenuation better than fixed-gain PI
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via 23-44% cost reduction under multiple disturbance scenarios

title: Adaptive fuzzy fault-tolerant PID controller design for a single-tank level process in the presence of sensor faults and disturbances
task: Fuzzy-PID level control for single-tank water system with sensor faults
key_results: Fuzzy-PID reduces overshoot and disturbance-recovery time vs. classical PID; tested on Arduino/MATLAB platform; systematic sensor fault injection and analysis performed
comments: Practical comparison of controllers in experimental setup; first-order system model derived from data; manual tuning eliminated via Simulink design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fuzzy-PID improves transient response and robustness to sensor faults vs. classical PID
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via real-time Arduino/MATLAB experiments; reduced overshoot and faster disturbance recovery observed

title: A weather integrated neural symbolic dispatch framework for power system operational security
task: Weather-integrated neuro-symbolic dispatch for power system operations
key_results: WINDS reduces operational cost by 11.4%-26.7% vs. static climatology; reduces constraint-violation volume >80% vs. forecast-only dispatch; novel L-consistency metric quantifies neural-symbolic alignment
comments: Hybrid neuro-symbolic framework balances data-driven weather forecasting with symbolic security constraints; demonstrated on Danish DK1 zone with real wind/load data.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neural methods for uncertainty + symbolic enforcement of constraints improves dispatch robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 11.4-26.7% cost reduction and >80% violation reduction vs. baselines

title: Multi-polarized nested metasurface antenna stacking for satellite-assisted Internet of Vehicles
task: Multi-polarized metasurface antenna design for satellite IoV
key_results: Compact 25×25 mm antenna with multi-band operation (7.4, 11.51, 14.15 GHz); gains of 3.8, 4.69, 8.82 dBi respectively; AR < 1.23 dB at Ku band
comments: Hardware fabrication and real-world rooftop testing valuable; integration of nested complementary split-ring metasurface with dual-flipped patch is novel.

title: Analysis of a chickenpox epidemic model through fractal–fractional differential operators: a computational study
task: Epidemic modeling using fractal-fractional derivatives
key_results: Established dimensional consistency, positivity, boundedness, existence and Ulam-Hyers stability; applied to Shenzhen chickenpox data 2015
comments: Fractal-fractional Caputo approach captures power-law memory effects better than integer-order models; parameter optimization via fmincon may be local.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fractal-fractional derivatives better capture chickenpox dynamics than classical approaches
hypotheses.result: Improved modeling capability demonstrated; positivity and stability verified theoretically

title: Jacobi-enhanced dynamic hypergraph learning for graph-based fraud detection
task: Graph-based fraud detection with dynamic hypergraph and spectral filtering
key_results: JK-DHGNN achieves competitive performance on YelpChi, Amazon, Elliptic; ablations reveal module effectiveness depends on dataset characteristics and relational structure
comments: Dual-view framework combines observed pairwise and latent higher-order interactions via Jacobi spectral filter; heterophilous graph support is key novelty.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining observed topology, latent higher-order modeling, and spectral filtering improves fraud detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on three benchmarks; ablations show module utility varies by dataset structure

title: Audit-first rollback semantics for safety–critical deployment pipelines
task: Audit-first rollback semantics for safety-critical deployment pipelines
key_results: Every audit-first trial ended in specified state; fail-open only achieved this at 5 of 28 sites; terminal record latency 35.7 ms at 99th percentile after guard widening
comments: Formal approach to deployment safety via provisional state machines; empirical evaluation exposed two guard gaps in initial implementation, demonstrating value of comprehensive fault injection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reverting before terminal record ensures audit consistency vs. fail-open behavior
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; after guard fix, all audit-first trials maintained coherence; fail-open failed at 23 sites

title: Acoustic analysis comparison and model optimization of Chinese ancient and modern oboes
task: Acoustic analysis and model optimization of Chinese ancient vs. modern oboes
key_results: Finite element models validated against studio measurements; SAPSO-BCM algorithm optimizes bell curvature; modern Suona achieves lower fundamental, smoother attenuation, concentrated directivity vs. Qing-era Sunaiyi
comments: Pioneering integrated 3D scanning, FEM, and swarm-optimization workflow for traditional instruments; structural parameter influence on radiation rigorously quantified.

model_io.model: Surrogate-Assisted Particle Swarm Optimization with K-means Clustering (SAPSO-BCM)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bell curvature shape significantly influences Suona acoustic radiation characteristics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via parametric optimization; modern steeper flare yields lower fundamental and smoother attenuation

title: A global–local feature enhancement-based method for vulnerable road user detection
task: Vulnerable road user detection in traffic scenes
key_results: GPL-YOLO achieves 90.5% Precision, 78.6% Recall, 87.4% mAP50, 55.8% mAP50–95 on KITTI_VRU with 3.093M parameters and 7.8 GFLOPs
comments: Multi-stage feature preservation (C3k2-GSB), attention (PLA), and localization-quality-aware loss (Focal-Wise IoU + TAL) are complementary; consistent gains on BDD100K_VRU demonstrate generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Localization-quality awareness in label assignment improves VRU detection accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by consistent mAP improvements on two datasets; superior to YOLOv11n

title: Document world models: a cognitive-inspired auxiliary training framework for document-level relation extraction
task: Document-level relation extraction with cognitive-inspired auxiliary training
key_results: Consistent improvements over baselines on Re-DocRED and HacRED, particularly on long-range cross-sentence relations; Entity State Tracking and Relation Belief Dynamics objectives stabilize predictions
comments: Document World Model (DocWM) is training-only auxiliary framework mimicking incremental reading; cognitive grounding is intuitive but causal mechanisms not fully validated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Progressive entity-state maintenance preserves early evidence for long-range relations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by improved performance on cross-sentence relations on two benchmarks

title: Action-conditioned latent Kalman filtering for robust spatio-temporal state estimation of deformable object
task: Robust spatio-temporal state estimation for deformable object manipulation
key_results: AC-LKF reduces observation-induced jitter and improves latent trajectory smoothness; PCA/t-SNE visualizations confirm better information retention
comments: Hybrid PointNet++/GRU with kinematic action conditioning is pragmatic; heteroscedastic filtering adaptively balances prior and noisy observations under occlusion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Action-conditioned kinematic priors improve temporal consistency of learned deformable-object representations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via temporal metrics and reconstruction error reduction; visual evidence via PCA/t-SNE

title: Emotional and behavioral asymmetries in user responses to virtual versus human influencers
task: Affective response comparison between AI and human influencers on social media
key_results: AIVI-directed comments show 24.8% positive vs. 41.5% for humans; MSEN classifier achieves F1=0.89 in distinguishing influencer types; reduced affective expression in both valences
comments: Large-scale analysis of 12M+ likes across 156,918 comments; finding of reduced rather than negative affect is nuanced boundary for CASA paradigm.

hypotheses.hypothesis: AIVIs and HIs evoke comparable affective responses
hypotheses.result: Rejected; AIVIs elicit reduced affect across both valences and less differentiated emotion patterns

title: Joint algorithm of pose estimation and motion retargeting for humanoid robot motion training
task: Joint pose estimation and motion retargeting for humanoid robots
key_results: Successfully retargeted human motion to 22-DoF humanoid with smooth trajectories avoiding skewing; validated on Mini-Pi-Plus platform
comments: Combines YOLOv8x, ViTPose-H, HMR2, and Transformer with unified SMPL-X intermediate; engineering validation on real platform is valuable but limited to single robot model.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint optimization reduces information loss compared to sequential pose-then-retargeting
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated smooth retargeting without skewing artifacts on real platform

title: Transient vibration analysis of liquid-filled pipelines under water hammer using a script-based CFD-CSM framework
task: Transient vibration analysis of pressurized pipelines under water hammer via CFD-CSM coupling
key_results: CFD validated to 3.30% peak pressure error; 3D framework more accurate than 1D 4-equation model in waveform/phase reproduction; modal added-mass coefficient ranges 0.001-0.68 across modes
comments: Script-based automated one-way load mapping enables repeated structural analyses; spatial non-uniformity of hydraulic loads crucial for accurate response prediction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 3D CFD-CSM more accurately reproduces water-hammer transients than 1D models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; better waveform, phase, and local response fidelity; mode-dependent added-mass quantified

title: Fuzzy adaptive PID attitude control of quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicle with airborne radar in autonomous flight mode
task: Fuzzy adaptive PID control for autonomous quadcopter in counter-drone mode
key_results: Yaw MAPE 0.1235%, pitch MAPE 0.1963% on tested trajectory; adaptive outer-loop outperforms fixed-gain PID in reducing attitude transients
comments: Cascade architecture with fuzzy parameter adaptation based on onboard radar measurements; 21-state Monte Carlo stability verification and parametric sensitivity analysis strengthen validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fuzzy adaptive outer-loop reduces attitude transients vs. fixed-gain cascade control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via simulation and experimental platform; MAPE errors < 0.2%

title: Learning What the Operator Misses: Residual Operator-Diffusion for Spatiotemporal PDE Solution Predictions
task: Hybrid neural operator and residual diffusion for PDE surrogates
key_results: Reduces error up to 81.8% over classical solvers; accelerates inference up to 650× on lid-driven cavity and elasto-plasticity benchmarks; resolves high-frequency transients missed by deterministic operators
comments: First hybrid framework coupling neural operator (DeepONet) with residual-conditioned video diffusion; targets operator error rather than full fields, addressing spectral bias.

inputs: system conditions (e.g., boundary conditions, loading history)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Residual-conditioned diffusion captures operator errors and transients better than deterministic surrogates alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 81.8% error reduction and 650× speedup vs. classical solvers on mechanics benchmarks

title: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
task: Probing magnetic order in quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions via magnon transmission
key_results: First magnon transmission across MLG-BLG quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunction; transmission onset at Zeeman energy with systematic variation across Landau levels; suppression at ν=4,8 where spin polarization vanishes
comments: Novel heterojunction magnon spectroscopy establishes a modular probe for magnetic order in dilute 2D systems, though limited to graphene platform so far.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnons generated in MLG can transmit through BLG to reveal spin order in distinct material
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; transmission exhibits sharp onset at Zeeman energy and suppression at ν=4,8

title: Imaging hot-electron Thomson cooling beyond the Boltzmann–Onsager framework
task: Imaging non-equilibrium hot-electron thermoelectric response beyond Boltzmann–Onsager classical framework
key_results: In HgTe weak electron-phonon coupling allows hot electrons to remain far from equilibrium, generating large electron temperature gradients and pronounced Thomson compensation; HgCdTe suppresses non-equilibrium state, recovering lattice-mediated response; measurements confirm departure from near-equilibrium predictions
comments: Direct spatial imaging of electron and lattice temperatures via coupled scanning-probe techniques is innovative, enabling exploration of fundamental non-equilibrium thermoelectric physics at nanoscale.

model_io.model: HgTe and HgCdTe nanoconstrictions under applied high electric field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weak electron-phonon coupling in HgTe maintains hot-electron far-from-equilibrium state, enhancing Thomson effect; strong coupling in HgCdTe restores lattice-mediated response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HgTe shows large non-equilibrium gradients and pronounced Thomson compensation; HgCdTe shifts toward lattice-dominated behavior

title: Comparative analysis of gate-dielectric effects on the analog and linearity performance of MoS2-, MoSe2-, and WS2-based FETs
task: Systematic study of gate-dielectric effects on analog, RF, and linearity performance of TMD-FETs
key_results: High-k dielectrics improve ON current, reduce SS, enhance transconductance efficiency (gm/ID), and shift nonlinear distortion peaks (gm2, gm3) to lower voltages; WS2 exhibits superior RF performance, MoS2 offers best power-efficiency tradeoff
comments: NEGF-based simulations provide microscopic transport insights, but experimental validation of predicted performance metrics across all material combinations would strengthen conclusions.

model_io.model: Self-consistent NEGF simulator for TMD-FETs (MoS2, MoSe2, WS2 channels)

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-k dielectrics enhance electrostatic control and shift nonlinearity peaks toward lower voltages, improving RF linearity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across all three TMD materials; WS2 shows best absolute performance

title: Microscopic observation of magnetization response shaped by magnetic anisotropy in a single magnetic nanoparticle
task: Characterizing single-particle magnetization response and magnetic anisotropy effects in magnetic nanoparticles
key_results: Direct observation of magnetization distribution in individual nanoparticles via MFM; quantified effects of anisotropy, field, and thermal fluctuations on orientation; comparison of single-particle vs. ensemble measurements
comments: MFM provides spatial resolution of magnetization that bulk measurements cannot access, enabling evaluation of dipolar effects between particles.

model_io.model: Single magnetic nanoparticle (Fe3O4 cores, variable diameter)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic anisotropy, applied field, and thermal fluctuations determine single-particle magnetization orientation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through systematic MFM measurement of particles with different core diameters

title: Simultaneous correction of spectral-line bending across multiple slits in a slit recombination hyperspectral imager with multiple viewing angles
task: Correcting spectral-line bending across multiple slits in multi-angle hyperspectral imagers
key_results: Dual-material prism group (H-QF3/D-ZLaF81-25) reduces maximum spectral-line bending to 0.0012–0.0024 mm (~94% reduction vs. reference); FWHM≤9.75 nm and distortion<0.5 pixels across 410–900 nm and three viewing angles (±15°, 0°)
comments: Genetic-algorithm optimization successfully addresses the multi-dimensional distortion problem, achieving stringent requirements for simultaneous multi-slit imaging.

model_io.model: Three-slit hyperspectral imager with dual-material prism disperser

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimized prism group can simultaneously correct spectral-line bending across all three slit channels and viewing angles below 10 nm requirement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; maximum FWHM 9.75 nm, all specifications met

title: Disorientation as a marker of neurotrauma in an animal that uses shock waves as weapons
task: Quantifying blast-induced neurotrauma in snapping shrimp via spatial disorientation metrics
key_results: Shock-wave-exposed shrimp without orbital hoods show longer path length, reduced speed, and higher path tortuosity in shelter-seeking; orbital hoods mitigate behavioral disorientation
comments: Behavioral proxies for neurotrauma provide a functional assay for blast protection, though causation between disorientation and actual neural injury is inferred.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shock wave exposure causes spatial disorientation in shrimp lacking orbital hoods, analogous to blast-induced neurotrauma in humans
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant increases in path tortuosity and distance traveled; orbital hoods mitigate effect

title: Low frequency noise characteristics of IGZO and IZO heterojunction oxide thin film transistors
task: Investigating low-frequency 1/f noise in IGZO/IZO heterojunction oxide TFTs with gate-bias-dependent buried-channel effects
key_results: Non-monotonic normalized noise with anomalous peak in intermediate gate overdrive region; TCAD and hysteresis analysis show gate-bias-dependent vertical carrier redistribution (buried IZO layer at low bias, front channel forms at high overdrive); heterojunction engineering reduces trap-induced fluctuations
comments: TCAD-supported understanding of non-intuitive noise behavior is insightful, though direct correlation of trap density to noise peaks could further validate the mechanism.

model_io.model: Self-aligned top-gate coplanar IGZO/IZO heterojunction TFT

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gate-bias-dependent vertical carrier migration from buried IZO to front IGZO/SiO2 interface causes non-monotonic noise with intermediate-bias anomaly
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by TCAD simulation showing buried carriers at low bias reduce SiO2 trap coupling, while high-bias forms front channel enhancing trap interactions

title: Electric-field-controlled spin transport in a vertical organic spin–field device for room-temperature spin logic
task: Electrical control of spin transport in organic vertical spin-field devices for room-temperature logic applications
key_results: Organic semiconductor/nanoporous ferromagnet interface enables fast electrical modulation of spin-polarized currents at room temperature; spin polarization controlled across full 0–100% range; demonstration of programmable spin-logic gates and arithmetic circuits
comments: Integration of spin transport and field-effect control in single organic vertical device is conceptually elegant, though scalability and operating frequency limits for practical digital applications warrant further investigation.

model_io.model: Vertical organic spin–field device (organic semiconductor/nanoporous ferromagnet stack)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electric field at organic/ferromagnet interface can modulate spin transport and control spin polarization without compromising coherence at room temperature
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; fast electrical modulation demonstrated; spin logic gates and circuits successfully implemented

title: Foundation model for particle collision data analysis
task: Foundation model for transfer-learning across high-energy collision data analysis tasks
key_results: EVENET pretrained on 500M simulated events outperforms baselines for heavy resonance and exotic Higgs decay searches; validated on experimental CMS data by rediscovering ϒ meson; up to 81.8% error reduction vs. classical surrogates
comments: Self-supervised pretraining on massive simulation dataset enables robust few-shot transfer, though extrapolation to genuine data anomalies remains challenging.

inputs: variable-length physics object sets (jets, leptons, MET)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pretraining on large simulation corpus with physics-informed supervision enables transfer to diverse downstream analyses
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent performance gains in low-statistics regimes; successful rediscovery of ϒ meson in experimental data
